allowance_interface.FINITE: Exact semantically filtered next characters for literal, choice, escape, separator, and reference substates.
allowance_interface.JSON_STRING_BODY: Structured Unicode-scalar allowance with control/surrogate exclusion, escape permission, and conditional closing quote.
allowance_interface.TERMINAL: No further character permitted; EOS may be considered by a separately authorized downstream layer.

semantic_filter: Finite candidates are admitted only when one immutable DFA advance succeeds, preventing structurally possible but obligation-invalid closers.

liveness_receipt.privacy_boundary: Receipt stores decoded hash/length but not decoded text.
liveness_receipt.failure: A nonterminal empty character allowance raises a typed fail-closed error carrying the receipt.

non_goals: No token IDs are selected and no vocabulary/trie/tokenizer is inspected.
No evaluator, runner, provider, probe, model, inference, Stage C, runtime authority, production authority, curriculum exposure, or training.
